newsitem.title: UK: BAA UPS CONVERTIBLE BOND TO 200 MLN STG.
newsitem.headline: BAA UPS CONVERTIBLE BOND TO 200 MLN STG.

text.p: BAA Plc's sterling convertible bond has been increased to 200 million stg from 175 million stg, it said in a statement on Thursday.
The deal was launched and priced on Wednesday via joint lead managers J. Henry Schroder & Co Ltd and UBS Ltd.
The conversion price was set at 672 pence stg per share, a 17.1 percent premium at the time of pricing.
The coupon was set at 4.875 percent, the bottom of the indicated 4.875-5.25 percent range.
The proceeds will be used to refinance in part BAA's acquisition of Duty Free International Inc.
